blocks.text: MANILA – Malacañang on Tuesday defended the Marcos administration’s handling of former president Rodrigo Duterte’s arrest and transfer to the International Criminal Court (ICC), saying the government did not abuse its authority. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro issued the statement after the Supreme Court (SC) dismissed consolidated petitions for habeas corpus seeking to challenge Duterte’s […]...
